query.normalizedText:
SELECT event_type, occurred_at
FROM events
WHERE customer_id = $1
ORDER BY occurred_at DESC
LIMIT $2

findings.title: Sequential scan with an unindexed filter
findings.evidence: Seq Scan on events filters customer_id (est. 7 of ~300000 rows, total cost 5442.50).

findings.title: Sort feeding a Limit (top-N could use an ordered index)
findings.evidence: Top-N sorts events by occurred_at (sort node cost 5442.62); an index in that order avoids the sort.

candidate.rationale: Equality on customer_id then order by occurred_at

validation.label: Planner-validated (HypoPG estimate): total cost 6443 → 9 (−99.9%). Estimate from the planner, not a runtime measurement.

valueRange.label: Across 4 sampled values of events.customer_id (HypoPG planner estimates): −97.5% for a common value of events.customer_id (0.1% of rows), up to −99.9% (generic plan: −99.9%, which is what the ranking uses).

footprint.label: Estimated index size 10.0 MB (HypoPG estimate), ≈33% of the table's 30.3 MB — every write to the indexed columns also maintains it.
